# Environment Configuration

Standard environment templates and configurations for benchmark runs.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `perf-box-amd64.env` | Hardware profile: AMD EPYC bare metal |
| `ci-runner.env` | GitHub Actions runner environment |
| `dev-laptop.env` | Developer machine environment |

See [docs/hardware-profiles.md](../../docs/hardware-profiles.md) for profile semantics.
